pins.name: COIL1
pins.description: coil (no polarity): 5 V across COIL1-COIL2 closes COM-NO

pins.name: NCLOSED
pins.description: NC, normally closed: joined to COM while the coil is off

pins.name: NO
pins.description: NO, normally open: joined to COM while the coil is on

recommended.what: contact current at 250 VAC (10 A version)

parameters.conditions: Coil at nominal 5 VDC, 20 degC, 0.36 W coil (L version) 71.4 mA; the 0.45 W (D version) coil draws 89.3 mA; coil resistance +/-10%

source.revision: Songle SRD series datasheet (coil specification table)
source.location: p. 1, coil specification table (0.36 W, L version), 05 VDC row

notes: The coil draws 71 mA at 5 V: drive it with a transistor or MOSFET (e.g. `mosfet(.n)` from the coil's low side to GND, the gate from a GPIO through 100 Ω with 10 kΩ to GND), never from a GPIO directly, and put a flyback diode (`diode(kind = .rectifier)`, 1N4148 or 1N4007) across the coil, cathode to 5 V.
Mains on COM/NO/NC: keep at least 6 mm of board (or a slot) between the contacts' copper and low-voltage copper, use wide tracks for the load current, and never route mains under the coil side.
Contacts 7, 10 or 15 A by version (the case print says which). The normally closed contact is named NCLOSED (NC means no-connect to PCBKit).

pins.source: Songle SRD series datasheet: C-type PCB layout (bottom view, mirrored here for the top view), outline dimensions, coil table (5 V, 71.4 mA, 70 Ω, pick-up 75 % max, drop-out 10 % min)
